rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Optimize distributions on distinct actual partition-forest runs, retaining the subtraction of posterior witness entropy. Derive computable lower or upper bounds for the resulting variational cost without identifying duplicate descriptions as distinct runs.

deliverables.description: POSTERIOR_FOREST_VARIATIONAL.tex: generator, distinct-run posterior, and cost bound
FOREST_WITNESS_EXAMPLES.json: explicit successful runs and their probabilities

acceptance_criteria: Count only distinct actual finite runs of one fixed random generator; identical descriptions of the same run cannot inflate posterior entropy.
Prove the variational identity or bound with the −H(posterior) term, including zero-probability and unsuccessful-run treatment.
Obtain a quantified estimate for an explicit family beyond the already calibrated one-root addressing case, or give a certified obstruction to that estimate.

Reuse the already derived normalized prior over complete reference laws. A new result must pay the expectation of the whole selected cost plus log₂(1/w_j); deriving the mixture inequality alone is baseline work.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A new computable bound on the true posterior residual, or an actual counterexample to the proposed bound, justifies a renewed pilot.

assignments.target_statement: Analyze conditioning on a nonempty initial root set and the term v log Z. Prove cancellation with rare-root costs on new overlapping families; never drop a negative normalization term before testing its mathematical role.

deliverables.description: ROOT_NORMALIZATION.tex: exact v(Λ+log₂Z) and root-rarity ledger

acceptance_criteria: Retain Z=1−2^(−Λ) after conditioning on nonempty roots and include the normalization term before any inequality.
Show cancellation or noncancellation with root surprisal uniformly as root probabilities tend to zero.
Use one admissible representation/weight system independent of the sampled Fourier set, and say whether a bad example refutes that system or the variational infimum.
When selecting a prior scale, keep its Λ_j and witness cost together and pay log₂(1/w_j) under one fixed prior. The recovered dyadic-prior normalization is a baseline, not a free adaptive choice.
assignments.renewal_milestone: An explicit cancellation theorem or sharp noncancellation family with its full influence comparison is ready for A006/A014.

assignments.target_statement: Construct codes that communicate each shared gate label once per complete spectral set. Prove decodability and account for gate names, attachments, subset choices, root choices, and the final output ambiguity.

deliverables.description: WHOLE_SET_CODEC.tex: encoder, decoder, shared codebook, and Kraft/subprobability proof
CODE_COST_LEDGER.json: gate labels, subsets, roots, attachments, ambiguity

acceptance_criteria: Describe every shared gate name at most once when the proposed code claims to reuse it, and provide a decoder for the complete Fourier set.
Account for the information required to choose or transmit the codebook; knowledge of the unknown spectral law is not free side information.
Prove finite successful decoding and compare total code length to the exact addressing H=2a benchmark before any new family claim.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A valid code with a quantified improvement for a named family, rather than a relabelled coordinatewise code, earns continuation.

assignments.target_statement: Choose global fractional gate weights subject to all coordinate incidence constraints. Derive an optimization dual or a verifiable certificate that bounds the expected residual for a meaningful family beyond bounded-read formulas.

deliverables.description: INCIDENCE_OPTIMIZATION.tex: primal constraints, objective, and proved dual bound
WEIGHT_CERTIFICATE.json: exact feasible weights or verified dual witness

acceptance_criteria: Verify Σ_{l:j∈R_l} λ_l≤1 for every coordinate with one global λ, including all zero/duplicate support conventions.
State whether the optimization objective is convex and prove any duality assertion used; numerical solver output alone is not a bound.
Exhibit a family with growing maximum read and a bounded certified cost-to-influence ratio, or isolate the exact term preventing that conclusion.

When using the recovered effective-piece lemma, verify disjoint physical supports and signed fiber-antichain hypotheses, with K_eff=(Σ_l√a_l)². Its derivative-weighted/global expected cost remains to be bounded.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A feasible primal/dual certificate controls a term of J on a class outside bounded-read hypotheses.

assignments.target_statement: Search for actual Boolean functions and all admissible representations in a bounded class for which the proposed residual-to-influence bound grows. Distinguish failure of one representation from failure of the variational infimum.

deliverables.description: RESIDUAL_SEARCH_SPEC.json: complete bounded representation class and parameter domain
RESIDUAL_FALSIFIER.md: Boolean witness and exact scope of failure

acceptance_criteria: Fix the candidate constant and all optimization freedoms before searching; certify the Boolean function independently of its representation.
If claiming failure of an infimum, enumerate or bound every admissible representation in the declared finite class, not merely the first DNF.
Use certified entropy comparisons for a surviving violation and distinguish a finite-domain certificate from an asymptotic family.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A certified representation-level or bounded-infimum failure with a precise distinction between them is the pilot outcome.
